A RESOLUTION OF THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN TO AUTHORIZE THE INCREASE OF THE FRANCHISE FEE APPLICABLE TO HOLDERS OF CABLE AND VIDEO FRANCHISES ISSUED BY THE STATE OF GEORGIA TO FIVE PERCENT AS ALLOWED BY LAW

WHEREAS, the Town currently collects a franchise fee of 2% of gross revenues generated in the Town from any current cable or video providers operating pursuant to a franchise issued by the State of Georgia pursuant to O.C.G.A. § 36-76-1 et seq. known as the “Consumer Choice for Television Act” of 2007 (the “‘Act”); and

WHEREAS, the Town considers collecting a franchise fee from a cable or video provider utilizing the public rights of way as compensation to the public for the use of the rights of way and a means of promoting the public health, safety , welfare and economics development of the Town and to protect public works infrastructure; and

WHEREAS, the Town of PINE MOUNTAIN is authorized under federal and state law to collect a franchise fee of up to 5% of the gross revenue generated in the Town by each cable or video provider operating in the Town under the Act.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN that franchise fee applicable to and charged against any cable or video state franchise holder's gross revenues received from the provision of cable or video service generated within the corporate boundaries of the TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, pursuant to a franchise issued by the State of Georgia pursuant to O.C.G.A. § 36-76-1 et seq. known as the “Consumer Choice for Television Act” of 2007 be, and it hereby, increased to 5% effective as of the final adoption of this Resolution.

RESOLVED by the Mayor and Council of the TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN thi

Authorized designee.

Cemetery Ordinance

Lot or plot defined:

A cemetery lot or plot shall mean and consist of enough land in which persons may be buried in single grave spaces, as defined in the plat of the cemetery and as described in the deed of the burial rights to the owner thereof.

Cemetery lots or burial space subject to restrictions, covenants, rules and regulations:

All cemetery plots, lots or burial space owned and purchased within the public cemetery of the city and all such plots, lots or spaces sold, shall be subject to the following restrictions, covenants, rules, regulations, amendments or alterations and ordinances as shall be adopted and regularly passed by the city from time to time, and the reference to these rules and regulations in the deed or certificate of ownership shall have the same force and effect as if fully set forth therein.

Sale of lots:

The selling of lots in the cemetery shall be done by the city clerk, who shall make out and deliver to the purchaser upon receipt of the purchase money, a deed to the same, which deed shall be signed by the mayor and the clerk, upon behalf of the city.

Purchase price of lots: The purchase price of lots in the public cemetery shall be as set out in the minutes of the City Council of the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia.

New enclosures: .

No new fences, walls, copings or other enclosures shall be placed upon or around any private burial lot in the cemetery, except upon plans submitted to and approved by the superintendent of public works.

Monument restrictions:

Monuments or stones of any kind, or enclosures shall not be permitted on the graves and plots of the cemetery. Only individual bronze memorial tablets or markers and bronze family name markers shall be allowed and they must be set subject to the approval and inspection of the city.

Monument construction:

All monuments must be of solid material base and die, marble or granite. Flush markers can be bronze. No other material is permitted. All monuments must have a concrete or cement foundation, not less than four (4) inches thick, of adequate strength and construction. All monuments and markers shall be in accordance with the regulations on file in the office of the city clerk.

Raising or depressing surface of lots or graves prohibited: The proprietors of cemetery lots are prohibited from raising or depressing the surface of the lot or graves above or below the surrounding ground.

Interments: No interment will be made in the cemetery without ndtification to the city hall.

Cemetery ordinance page 2

Visitation heurs: The city cemetery shall be open for visitation during the following hours: One-half hour after sunup; and One-half hour before sundown.

Automobiles regulated: Automobiles shall not be driven through the grounds at a greater speed than 10 miles per hour, and must always be kept on the right-hand side of the cemetery roadway. Automobiles are not allowed to park or to come to a full stop in front of an open grave unless such automobiles are in attendance at the funeral. No off-road recreational vehicles shall be allowed in city cemeteries.

Maintenance account:

The city shall establish a maintenance account for the long-term care and preservation of the cemetery. Monies for this account will be derived from the sale of cemetery lots.

The maintenance account established herein shall be a part of the city's general trust fund, and will include, in addition to the fees designated above, all donations and other appropriations relating to cemeteries which the city may deem proper. The city can use only the interest from said maintenance account for the care and preservation of the city cemetery.
